basic.name: 普通攻击：雷霆击
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：电光盾冲
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动两次盾击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launch two shield attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，蓄力完成后赛斯将向前方突进，发动高量级的连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动时，会为自身累积75%[意气]；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
连续斩击期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack]to charge the move, and Seth will dash forward, unleashing a series of powerful slashes, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging this skill, and damage taken is reduced by 40%.
Seth is invulnerable during the consecutive slashes.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：以退为进
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动快速的下砸斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleash a quick downward slash on enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：最终制裁
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动时，会为自身累积75%[意气]；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of slashes in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：正义必胜
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行连续上挑攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动时，会为自身累积75%[意气]，额外回复3点支援点数；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a series of upward attacks in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve, and grants 3 additional Assist Points.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：武力支援
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动快速的下砸斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a quick downward slash on enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：迅雷盾
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动时，会为自身累积25%[意气]；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Upon activation, gain 25% Resolve.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：治安裁决
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动突刺攻击，随后进行两次横扫斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch a forward thrust attack, followed by two horizontal slashes, dealing Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the squad member positioned before Seth.
After activating the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to transition to EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage and charge faster.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 终结一击命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the squad member positioned before Seth.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the squad member positioned before Seth.

facts.text: 赛斯发动[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，会获得等同于自身40%初始攻击力的护盾[匪石之盾]，最高不超过3000点，持续25秒，10秒内最多触发一次；队伍中其他角色通过[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]或[支援突击：治安裁决]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，会为该队友提供等同于赛斯40%初始攻击力的护盾[匪石之盾]，最高不超过3000点，持续25秒，10秒内最多触发一次；拥有[匪石之盾]时，持有者的异常精通提升50点。
facts.textEn: When Seth uses EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, he gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 40% of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified or Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling triggers a Quick Assist or Chain Attack, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 40% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a Shield of Firm Resolve increases Anomaly Proficiency by 50.

facts.text: 赛斯发动[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，会获得等同于自身80%初始攻击力的护盾[匪石之盾]，最高不超过3000点，持续25秒，10秒内最多触发一次；队伍中其他角色通过[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]或[支援突击：治安裁决]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，会为该队友提供等同于赛斯80%初始攻击力的护盾[匪石之盾]，最高不超过3000点，持续25秒，10秒内最多触发一次；拥有[匪石之盾]时，持有者的异常精通提升100点。
facts.textEn: When Seth uses EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, he gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 80% of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified or Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling triggers a Quick Assist or Chain Attack, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 80% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a Shield of Firm Resolve increases Anomaly Proficiency by 100.

cinema.name: 英雄主义
cinema.description: [匪石之盾]提供的护盾及其上限提升30%，[匪石之盾]失效时，[核心被动：守望者]提供的异常精通提升效果额外维持10秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: The shield value provided by Shield of Firm Resolve and its maximum limit is increased by 30%. When Shield of Firm Resolve ends, the Anomaly Proficiency increase provided by Core Passive: Protector lasts an additional 10s.

cinema.name: 年少轻狂
cinema.description: 进入战场时，赛斯立刻为自身累积75%[意气]；发动[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]命中敌人时，招式累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering battle, Seth immediately gains 75% Resolve. Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified increases the move's accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 35%.

cinema.name: 钝感力
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 初心
cinema.description: [招架支援：迅雷盾]造成的失衡值提升25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Daze caused by Defensive Assist: Thundershield is increased by 25%.

cinema.name: 憧憬的距离
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 理想主义
cinema.description: 赛斯在[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]中发动终结一击命中敌人时，额外造成自身500%攻击力的伤害，本次攻击必定触发暴击，且暴击伤害提升60%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.

招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a quick downward slash on enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
After the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

127100002.name: 普通攻击：雷霆击-感电
127100002.description:
[意气]大于等于75%时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
消耗75%[意气]向前方发动持续攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成电属性伤害；
终结一击命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
127100002.descriptionEn:
When Resolve is above or equal to 75%, hold [Basic Attack] to activate.
Consume 75% Resolve to launch consecutive attacks in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Electric DMG.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the squad member positioned before Seth.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

127100005.name: 强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特
127100005.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage
127100005.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，蓄力完成后赛斯将向前方突进，发动高量级的连续斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动时，会为自身累积75%[意气]；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
连续斩击期间拥有无敌效果。
127100005.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack]to charge the move, and Seth will dash forward, unleashing a series of powerful slashes, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging this skill, and damage taken is reduced by 40%.
Seth is invulnerable during the consecutive slashes.

127100013.name: 招架支援：迅雷盾
127100013.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动时，会为自身累积25%[意气]；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
127100013.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Upon activation, gain 25% Resolve.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

127100014.name: 支援突击：治安裁决
127100014.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方发动突刺攻击，随后进行两次横扫斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动后，长按 【强化特殊技键】 衔接[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，能够以更快的速度完成蓄力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
127100014.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch a forward thrust attack, followed by two horizontal slashes, dealing Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the squad member positioned before Seth.
After activating the move, hold [EX Special Attack] to transition to EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage and charge faster.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1271-core-12.name: 核心被动：守望者
1271-core-12.description: 赛斯发动[强化特殊技：电光盾冲-高伏特]时，会获得等同于自身40%初始攻击力的护盾[匪石之盾]，最高不超过3000点，持续25秒，10秒内最多触发一次；队伍中其他角色通过[普通攻击：雷霆击-感电]或[支援突击：治安裁决]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，会为该队友提供等同于赛斯40%初始攻击力的护盾[匪石之盾]，最高不超过3000点，持续25秒，10秒内最多触发一次；拥有[匪石之盾]时，持有者的异常精通提升50点。
1271-core-12.descriptionEn: When Seth uses EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, he gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 40% of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified or Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling triggers a Quick Assist or Chain Attack, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 40% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a Shield of Firm Resolve increases Anomaly Proficiency by 50.
